from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyRevenue(BaseModel):
    """Extracted revenue data from a single company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company filing the report")
    revenue_value: float | None = Field(description="The reported revenue amount as a number (e.g., 3622)")
    revenue_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the reported amount (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by the data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_revenues: list[CompanyRevenue]
